Kerala CM's remark sparks debate over Champakulam boat race holiday

The Kerala government has decided not to declare a local holiday for the Champakulam boat race, following a controversy sparked by Chief Minister V D Satheesan's open-mic remark. The event is scheduled to take place on January 10th and is an important festival in the region. The decision was made after a meeting between the CM and the district collector, who had initially proposed declaring a holiday due to the event's popularity. The controversy surrounding the CM's remark has raised questions about the government's handling of local festivals and traditions.
